svg.aria-label: Handle by cell type: SS blocking cells are not charged and contain no lithium metal, and can be opened directly; Li symmetric cells contain lithium metal and are opened in the glovebox; half cells and full cells are charged: discharge them first and wrap both terminals with insulating tape.
